mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Read or analyze an ABAP profiler trace: the hit list, the statements, the database accesses.

description: [read-only] Reads the ABAP profiler trace named by trace_id_or_uri in the view given (hit list, statements or database accesses), raw or analysed. Required: trace_id_or_uri*, view*(hitlist|statements|db_accesses). Optional: mode(raw|analyze, default raw), top(analyze only), with_system_events, id, with_details, auto_drill_down_threshold. Response: JSON. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. Optional timeout (seconds): when it passes, the read is cancelled, its ABAP session logged off, and the system stays as it was. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a client's cancel ends only the client's wait, and SAP runs the read on. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

mode.description: "raw" returns the parsed trace payload as-is (default). "analyze" returns a compact summary instead — totals plus the top-ranked entries — via the same trace view.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer: a whole number, at least 1, no default — without it the call waits until SAP answers. When it passes, the read is cancelled (its ABAP session is logged off) and the call answers that nothing was changed. Set it below your MCP client's request limit — the TypeScript SDK's client cancels at 60 s; a cancel does nothing to SAP.

top.description: Number of top-ranked rows to include when mode is "analyze". Default 10. Ignored for mode "raw".

name: HandlerProfileView
